decisions.reason: It survived while a similar low-pile decorative carpet was already removed, so the firm has a positive signal on A and the option value of keeping it open remains favorable.

Its continued dedicated presentation suggests the premium carpet still supports a differentiated niche, and the firm is likely to keep testing this option because website presence is relatively cheap.
The downgrade from a full product page to only a brief website mention indicates weak commitment and likely enough negative information to justify abandoning this higher-commitment furniture option.
Like A, it remained on its own page into 2024, which signals acceptable early performance and makes continued observation more attractive than immediate exit.
As a core furniture item that still has full website support, the chair looks strategically closer to the firm’s main business and worth keeping unless clearer negative evidence emerges.
